info.title: Finalechat API
info.summary: The app where agents message the user.
info.description: Threads of messages and questions between agent sessions and one user, with long-polling, server-sent events and Web Push. Human-readable reference: https://www.finalechat.com/api/ . Agent quick start: https://www.finalechat.com/AGENTS.md .

tags.name: Messages
tags.description: Markdown or text messages in a thread.

tags.name: Attachments
tags.description: Files and screenshots carried by messages; bytes in object storage, metadata in the API.

tags.name: Questions
tags.description: Multiple-choice and free-form questions the user answers on their phone.

tags.name: Push
tags.description: Web Push device registration for the app.

get.description: text/event-stream of `ready`, `thread.created`, `thread.updated`, `thread.deleted, thread.activity ({at, thread_id, activity}; no thread, no counts), question.dismissed, ping ({at} every 20 seconds)`, `message.created, message.deleted ({at, thread, message_id})`, `question.created`, `question.answered`, `question.cancelled`, `question.expired`, `settings.updated` and `reconnect` events. Each data payload carries the full current objects (`thread`, `message`, `question`, `settings`) plus `counts` and `at`. A `: ping` comment is sent every 20 seconds.

post.summary: Set the agent's status line (never creates a thread)
post.description: What the agent is doing right now, shown in the app as a typing indicator with a timer. Lapses after ttl_seconds unless set again and is dropped when the agent posts a message or question without its own activity field. Never notifies, does not bump last_activity_at, and returns 404 for an unknown thread. Emits thread.activity. PUT is accepted as an alias.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Thread UUID or `ext:<external_id>`.

200.description: The thread; applied is false when the write was ignored (stale seq or an unchanged repeat).

404.description: Not found

delete.description: Drops the status now. Emits thread.activity when there was one. Never creates a thread.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Thread UUID or `ext:<external_id>`.

parameters.name: seq
parameters.description: Ordering for concurrent writers: status writes with a lower seq than this clear are ignored afterwards. Use the same clock as the writes (nanosecond timestamps).

200.description: The thread; `thread.activity` is the new status or null.

get.summary: List messages, or wait for new ones

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Thread UUID or `ext:<external_id>`.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return messages newer than this id (ascending). Required with wait.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Return messages older than this id (ascending).

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Seconds to hold the request open for a message newer than `after`. Clamped to 600.

parameters.name: after_time
parameters.description: Return messages created after this instant (ascending); used with wait when there is no message id to anchor on. Take it from a previous response's waited_from.

200.description: Messages in ascending order. `has_more` reports older messages (or newer ones beyond limit when using after). `timed_out` is true when a wait elapsed with nothing new.

waited_from.description: Present on anchorless waits: the instant the server started watching, by its own clock. Pass it back as after_time.

anchor_unknown.description: Present and true when after named a message the thread does not hold; the page then started from the thread's first message.

post.summary: Upload files to attach to a later message
post.description: Creates a missing ext: thread on demand. Send multipart/form-data with one or more file parts (any field name; at most 8), or a raw body whose Content-Type is the file type with the filename in X-Filename or ?filename=. Images (png, jpeg, gif, webp) get dimensions and a JPEG thumbnail. Uploads not attached to a message within 24 hours are deleted.

get.description: Returns only message_id and thread_id within this artifact's own thread. Validates declared dataset format/session identity and exactly one selector. parameters.description: JSON object containing dataset_format and session_id, plus exactly one of seq (positive safe integer), event_id, message_id, or file and line. Identifiers are within 200 UTF-8 bytes. Unknown keys and trailing JSON are rejected.

parameters.name: viewer
parameters.description: Explicit renderer revision from the same artifact. Requires equal declared dataset format/schema. Replaces only viewer-role files; every source/context/asset/derived file remains from the selected data revision. Does not commit a revision or change current. Incompatible file layouts return 422. Composed manifests record both revision IDs and have no settings entrypoint; incompatible with surface=settings. Omit to read the original archive.

get.summary: Discover live settings for a thread
get.description: Returns up to 100 session resource links (id, label, generation, available), newest first. The connector snapshot may declare details.thread_external_id as a navigation hint. Thread, connector and resource must belong to the account; only active connectors and session-scoped resources appear. This does not create bindings or grant mutation authority. Availability also requires a recent connector heartbeat and runtime_known=true.
